excluded.title: Study 2
excluded.reason: Randomised trial but population is HIV-infected adults, not children <15 years or infants <18 months with HIV-infected mothers. Wrong population.

excluded.title: Study 3
excluded.reason: Randomised trial of cotrimoxazole prophylaxis, but population is adults (patients with Kaposi's sarcoma, typical adult AIDS presentation; adult dosing 800/160 mg twice daily; no mention of children). Does not meet age criteria. Wrong population.

excluded.title: Study 4
excluded.reason: Case series of four homosexual men; not a randomised or quasi-randomised trial. Also wrong population (adults). Not an intervention study.

excluded.title: Study 5
excluded.reason: Cross-sectional necropsy study of children who died; no intervention, not a trial. Does not compare cotrimoxazole vs placebo/no treatment.

excluded.title: Study 6
excluded.reason: Prospective cohort study (observational) comparing HIV-infected vs uninfected children. Not a randomised or quasi-randomised trial. No intervention of cotrimoxazole prophylaxis.

excluded.title: Study 7
excluded.reason: Prospective observational study of morbidity in HIV-infected and uninfected children. Not a trial; no cotrimoxazole prophylaxis intervention.

excluded.title: Study 8
excluded.reason: Randomised controlled trial but in HIV-infected adults with tuberculosis (median age 32, range 18-64). Does not meet population criteria (children <15 or infants <18 months).

excluded.title: Study 9
excluded.reason: Review/editorial about mother-to-child transmission. Not a trial, no intervention. Not relevant study design.

excluded.title: Study 10
excluded.reason: Prospective observational study of PCP incidence in HIV-infected children. Not a randomised or quasi-randomised trial. Although some children were on prophylaxis, the study does not compare cotrimoxazole vs placebo/no treatment in a controlled design.
